deadline.value: Fall applications for the doctorate are due May 1, with supplemental materials due May 15; applications are reviewed on a rolling basis.

fee_waiver.value: Doctoral applicants who already have a confirmed faculty advisor can ask the department to waive the fee.
fee_waiver.quote: Doctoral applicants who have a confirmed faculty advisor prior to submitting the application are eligible for an application fee waiver

gre_subject.value: The department pages checked do not mention a GRE.

supervisor.value: Students are admitted only when a faculty member agrees to be their adviser.
supervisor.quote: Students are normally only admitted to our program if a faculty member has agreed to serve as the adviser.

funding.value: Funding is not guaranteed; applicants can ask faculty about funding in their research area.
funding.quote: Funding is not guaranteed but an applicant can contact a faculty member in their research area to inquire about potential funding.

entry_route.value: Applicants typically hold a master's; a direct bachelor's entry is possible but discouraged.
entry_route.quote: Applicants to the doctoral program in Mechanical Engineering will typically have completed a master’s degree in Mechanical Engineering or a related field.

notes: Mechanical Engineering PhD requires 81 credits; the Materials track is not a separate PhD on these pages.
